notes.title: Development Update
notes.content:
Sorry for the slow development of the game.

The Game was supposed to release last month but i still think the game needs a lot of polish and bug fixing.

Ill Release the game as soon as its finished!

Thank you.

-AwerVBuddy

notes.title: Small Bug Fixes update
notes.content:
fixed flashlight,
changed credits,
new level selector screen.

very small update indeed

notes.title: The Full Game
notes.content:
For people who still play the game, not many, but some.

The game will be launching soon, and the next update will be the last update this demo is going to have.

extra features i want to be in the full game and the chances of it being there : 

- Level Editor with Steam Workshop (maybe after the release)

- Online (maybe)

- 15 Levels (guaranteed)

- 16 achievements (probably)

- English and Portuguese from brazil (probably)

- Full Soundtrack for a cheap price (probably)

Thanks For Playing the game!
